title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.42146v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Planning with world models enables test-time adaptation for embodied agents, offering superior generalization over direct policy learning. However, long-horizon tasks remain hindered by cumulative errors and search complexity. Existing hierarchical methods often use rigid macro-actions or latent skills, leading to brittle representations and limited fine-grained control. We introduce ID-WM (Implicit Dynamics World Models), a hierarchical world model that decouples state-space reachability from local control. Our framework utilizes a high-level model to sample feasible transitions across the state manifold and a low-level world model as an inverse dynamics solver to ground these transitions into precise actions. This allows the planner to identify reachable subgoals without being constrained by low-level execution details. translated_title: 基于隐式动力学的分层世界模型
translated_abstract: 利用世界模型进行规划能够使具身智能体在测试时进行自适应，相比直接策略学习具有更强的泛化能力。然而，长时程任务仍受到累积误差和搜索复杂度的制约。现有的分层方法往往采用僵化的宏动作或潜在技能，导致表示脆弱且细粒度控制能力有限。我们提出了 ID-WM（隐式动力学世界模型），这是一种将状态空间可达性与局部控制解耦的分层世界模型。该框架利用高层模型在状态流形上采样可行的状态转移，并将低层世界模型作为逆动力学求解器，将这些转移落地为精确的动作。这使得规划器能够在不受低层执行细节约束的情况下识别可达的子目标。通过优先考虑局部物理可行性而非全局行为模式，ID-WM 能够合成新颖的长时程规划……
tldr: ID-WM 提出了一种将状态可达性与局部控制解耦的隐式动力学分层世界模型，由高层模型在状态流形上采样可行状态转移、低层逆动力学模型将其转化为精确动作，从而有效缓解长时程任务中的累积误差与搜索复杂度问题。
en_tdlr: ID-WM is a hierarchical world model with implicit dynamics that decouples state-space reachability from local control, using a high-level model to sample feasible transitions on the state manifold and a low-level inverse dynamics solver to ground them into precise actions, thereby mitigating cumulative errors and search complexity in long-horizon tasks.
